title.en: Overview of the African Development Bank
title.hi: Overview of the African Development Bank

content.en: The **African Development Bank Group** comprises three entities: the African Development Bank, the African Development Fund, and the Nigeria Trust Fund. Its primary objective is to spur sustainable economic development and social progress in its regional member countries. It functions as a **multilateral development bank** that provides loans, equity investments, and technical assistance to both public and private sector projects.

definition.en: The bank prioritizes projects that foster trade and connectivity between African nations.

content.en: Students often confuse the AfDB with the African Union; remember that the AfDB is a financial institution, not a political body.
